objective: Preallocate COPY STDIN row buffers from in-memory payload line counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate COPY STDIN rows
tasks.result: COPY STDIN now estimates row capacity from the already-buffered payload before CSV/text parsing.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
cargo fmt was applied once, then the COPY unit tests and PostgreSQL COPY STDIN integration test were rerun against the final formatted state.
File-based COPY still uses the generic reader path with zero initial row capacity, avoiding any extra file scan.
